svg.title: Tradipitant vs placebo: who vomited after a semaglutide shot
svg.desc: Tradipitant vs placebo: who vomited after a semaglutide shot. Phase 2, Study 2601 (Nov 2025): placebo 58.6%, tradipitant 29.3%. Phase 3, Study 3601 (Oct 27, 2026): placebo 58.5%, tradipitant 43.0%.
